events.title: October 19, 2026 — Steam Next Fest & QoL Improvements
events.summary: Hey everyone 👋 Steam Next Fest is here, and we’ve just released a new update for the If Red Then Stop demo! 🚦 With more of you jumping into the demo during Next Fest, we wanted to make working with your state machines faster, clearer, and more comfortable. This update adds box selection, Shift multi-selection, Select All, improved autocompletion, clearer active states and fired transitions, plus several fixes and improvements under the hood. events.title: 16.09.2026 Demo Bug fixes and improvements
events.summary: Hey everyone Thanks to all your feedback on the demo, we have already made some improvements:Relational operators or equal signs are now auto spaced.Added AND and OR auto correction.Fixed an issue where too many spaces were added for the := or inverse operator.AND has now priority over OR in the ST CFG.Fixed an issue where a CFG priority command could drill down on a NOT statement, taking over priority instead of stopping.Improved result saving process.Added tutorial skips to the timer tutorial

We carefully went through it and used it to improve the game and put together this new demo. And there’s more to play this time: the demo includes two additional levels that weren’t part of the playtest, giving you even more programming and logic problems to solve. events.summary: You know that moment when you’re stuck in traffic and think,“Why is this light still red? 🤬”Well… we made a game about that.🎉 Say hello to If Red Then Stop.
